title: Child support income withholding - federal framework
facts: Income withholding is a central enforcement mechanism for child support and is generally required for support orders under applicable federal and state rules.
The Consumer Credit Protection Act sets federal maximum limits on how much disposable earnings may be garnished for support obligations.

For child support or alimony, the federal CCPA maximum can range from 50% to 65% of disposable earnings depending on whether the worker supports another spouse or child and whether payments are more than 12 weeks in arrears.
State law can provide lower garnishment limits.
